baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence at words 3-9 moves from believing and doing reparative deeds through the Compassionate's future making to wudd.
baseline_models.mechanism: Settled assent becomes intentional anti-corruptive practice; the Compassionate then renders its social result as an actual condition of affection.

activation_trace.role: Heart-settling assent supplies the inwardly trusted starting state.
Intentional action carries the inward state into chosen practice.
Soundness opposed to corruption gives the practice a reparative direction.
Rendering something into a condition supplies the transition from practice to social state.
Tender mercy and beneficence characterize the agent of the transformation.
Love and mutual affection name the resulting social condition.

changed_reading.before: Believers who do good receive a general promise of being loved.
changed_reading.after: Secure assent becomes intentional repair, and the Compassionate converts that repaired practice into a conferred social condition of affection.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The combination of عملوا الصالحات, سيجعل, and ودا at words 4-9 permits a specifically interpersonal mechanism.
baseline_models.mechanism: Human dealings that remove estrangement are not merely classified as good; they are made to settle into reciprocal affection.

activation_trace.role: Dealings between people supply the interpersonal site of the acts.
Reconciliation that removes mutual aversion supplies the acts' operative content.
Rendering into a condition turns episodic reconciliation into a settled relation.
Mutual affection is the durable relation produced when estrangement is removed.

changed_reading.before: Righteous deeds are an undifferentiated class rewarded with favor.
changed_reading.after: The deeds can be read as reconciliatory dealings whose divinely stabilized yield is reciprocal affection.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: عملوا, سيجعل, لهم, and ودا form a work-assignment-beneficiary-result chain inside the focus ayah.
baseline_models.mechanism: The wage branch of work and the appointed-fee branch of making jointly open a nonmonetary compensation frame in which affection itself fills the recompense slot.

activation_trace.role: Work's wage or provision supplies the remuneration frame.
An appointed fee for work supplies the act of assigning recompense.
Affection fills the assigned compensation slot instead of money.

changed_reading.before: Love is one unspecified reward among others.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the verse appoints affection itself as the nonmonetary recompense of reparative work.

context_deltas.mechanism: The claimed future of wealth and offspring ends in solitary arrival, while the focus promise assigns affection; wudd is thereby repriced as a durable alternative to accumulated property and genealogical continuation.

activation_trace.role: Accumulated wealth supplies the claimant's first imagined reward currency.
Offspring from one's line supplies the claimant's imagined continuity.
The isolated individual removes both possessions and lineage from the arrival scene.
The appointed recompense branch lets the focus promise answer the earlier reward claim.
Affection becomes the alternative value that the Compassionate actually assigns.

structural_cues: 19:77 projects مالا وولدا into the future; 19:80 strips the speaker to فردا; 19:96 supplies a different future object, ودا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rival future goods and solitary arrival; I infer a substitution of value, while the live alternative is that the promise of wudd is not directly pricing the earlier claim.

changed_reading.before: Affection is a nonmaterial wage inferred from focus-root branches alone.
changed_reading.after: Affection reads as the deliberately nonpossessable, nongenealogical recompense set against the claimant's wealth-and-offspring economy.

context_deltas.mechanism: Acquired divine patrons are intended to become honor for their clients but reverse into opponents; the Compassionate's direct making of wudd supplies the contrasting relation that human patronage cannot manufacture.

activation_trace.role: Taking as acquisition supplies the attempt to manufacture a patronal relation.
Strength and honor after abasement name the social power sought from those patrons.
Contradictory opposition marks the acquired relation's reversal.
Divine rendering supplies the counter-mode of producing a social condition.
Affection replaces brittle prestige with a positively attached relation.

structural_cues: The matched beneficiary phrases ليكونوا لهم عزا and سيجعل لهم الرحمن ودا align sought honor with given affection, after the former becomes ضدا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the parallel beneficiary constructions and the patronage reversal; I read wudd as a counter-gift to sought izz, though it may instead be an independent reward with no direct substitution.

changed_reading.before: The Compassionate generally grants love to believers.
changed_reading.after: The Compassionate grants reliable belonging as a counter-patronage to the honor people try, and fail, to acquire through substitute gods.

context_deltas.mechanism: Two gathered movements terminate differently: protected people arrive before the Compassionate as a delegation, while criminals are driven to their destination; wudd gains the concrete social shape of welcomed reception.

activation_trace.role: Gathering a group toward a destination supplies the collective movement.
Arrival before one possessing authority casts the protected group as an acknowledged delegation.
Driving and expulsion supply the coercive counter-mode of movement.
Arrival at a destination completes the parallel while preserving its harsher mode.
Merciful beneficence characterizes the authority receiving the first group.
Affection names the welcomed relation made for that collective.

structural_cues: 19:85-86 pair collective motion and terminal accusatives, إلى الرحمن وفدا versus إلى جهنم وردا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies contrasting modes of arrival; I infer that wudd names the reception fitting the delegation, while the alternative is that arrival and later affection are separate promises.

changed_reading.before: Wudd is an abstract favorable feeling.
changed_reading.after: Wudd becomes a reception-status: the protected are gathered into a welcomed delegation rather than driven as an undifferentiated mass.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context's boiling, hissing agitation is set against the focus ayah's heart-settling trust and made affection, yielding two opposed forms of unseen affective causation.

activation_trace.role: Boiling that emits a hiss supplies a kinetic image for incited agitation.
Security and heart-stillness supply the opposite affective state.
Rendering into a condition makes the settled state an effected outcome.
Affection is the socially shared form of that settlement.

structural_cues: 19:83 and 19:96 both depict an unseen agent producing a human affective disposition, but with opposed agents and results.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies boiling agitation and secure affection; I supply the settling-versus-inciting contrast, while the alternative is to keep azz as coercive urging without a thermal or affective bridge.

changed_reading.before: Faith and affection form a positive sequence.
changed_reading.after: The sequence is also counter-agitation: secure assent is made socially contagious as affection rather than being driven into a boil.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pericope allows association by covenant and intercession, rejects offspring attributed to the Compassionate, and names all as servants; wudd then becomes a granted, nonprocreative mode of closeness.

activation_trace.role: A mediator joining another supplies an authorized form of association.
A preserved covenant supplies the authorization for that association.
Biological offspring supplies the relation explicitly attributed and then rejected.
Submissive service supplies the universal creaturely relation that remains.
Kinship and womb-relation in the divine title's root opens a cautious relational resonance without asserting descent.
Affection supplies the positive bond that does not require divine filiation.

structural_cues: The repeated الرحمن of 19:87-93 rejects ولد and culminates, after universal عبدا, in الرحمن making ودا at 19:96.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rejected descent, authorized association, servitude, and a kinship branch under ر ح م; I infer a rerouting from genealogy to affection, while the live alternative is that الرحمن carries only mercy here.

changed_reading.after: After divine offspring is denied, the same title makes a nonprocreative, covenant-compatible bond of affection among servants.

context_deltas.mechanism: A false relational claim generates cascading fracture, while reparative deeds and divinely made affection generate cohesion; wudd becomes the social opposite of a world-splitting utterance.

activation_trace.role: Opening and splitting supply the first material image of disintegration.
A group's fissure through disagreement bridges cosmic cracking to social division.
Violent breaking and demolition complete the context's disintegration sequence.
Reconciliation that removes aversion supplies the counter-process to social fissure.
Rendering into a condition supplies the constructive directional arrow.
Mutual affection supplies the cohesive social result.

structural_cues: 19:89-90 move from one relational assertion to cosmic fracture; 19:96 moves from plural reparative acts to one divinely produced relation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fracture images and focus branches of reconciliation and affection; I infer a reparative answer, while the alternative is that 19:96 follows the judgment sequence without reversing its cosmic mechanics.

changed_reading.after: Righteous action is anti-fissure practice, and the Compassionate makes wudd as the cohesion opposed to divisive speech.

context_deltas.mechanism: Exhaustive counting and solitary arrival preserve each person distinctly; the immediate shift to الذين and لهم with wudd re-associates those accounted singles as a relational plural without erasing individuality.

activation_trace.role: Exhaustive numerical reckoning supplies complete individuation.
Counting the counted reinforces person-by-person determination.
The solitary one supplies the immediate pre-focus social condition.
Rendering into a new condition supplies re-association after individuation.
Mutual affection supplies the relation made for the restored plural.

structural_cues: 19:94-95 narrow from exhaustive plural accounting to كلهم...فردا; 19:96 immediately reopens the plural with الذين and لهم.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact individuation followed by plural beneficiaries; I infer relational reconstitution, while the alternative is that each individual separately receives affection from an unspecified source.

changed_reading.before: Affection is simply granted to a preexisting believer-group.
changed_reading.after: Affection is the new relational field made for fully accounted individuals after each has stood alone.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after wudd is promised, the message is made easy on the tongue to bring joy and confront intense contentiousness; affection becomes a speakable public disposition set against ludd rather than a hidden feeling.

activation_trace.role: Ease opening after difficulty supplies communicative accessibility.
Language and speech supply the public medium.
News that opens the face with joy supplies an affective speech-act.
Intense contentiousness supplies the opposed public disposition.
Affection supplies the public disposition whose sound and sense contrast with ludd.

structural_cues: The adjacent verse endings ودا and لدا create a tight sound contrast, while 19:97 explicitly places the second term in a tongue-and-message scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency, sound contrast, eased language, joyful news, and contentiousness; I infer communicative mediation of wudd, while the alternative is that 19:97 concerns delivery only and does not cause the promised affection.

changed_reading.before: Wudd is inward affection produced without a specified medium.
changed_reading.after: Wudd is a publicly articulable and joy-bearing relation poised against ludd, with eased proclamation as a possible means of social transformation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the peg sense is a form-distant branch of و د د, not the ordinary sense of ودا. It remains anchored by that exact focus branch and by the packet's splitting and demolition sequence. Downstream prose should render it only as a material analogy, affection as a fastener, never as a lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: سيجعل...ودا at words 6 and 9 can activate making or setting a peg-like fastener after the rupture imagery of 19:90.

activation_trace.role: Fissure and opening supply the material break that would require fastening.
Violent demolition raises the scale of the instability.
Making or bringing a thing about supplies the act of setting the stabilizer.
The assimilated peg sense supplies the material image of a fastener.

changed_reading.before: The Compassionate will create love for them.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, the Compassionate sets affection like a fastener that holds a fissured social world together.

strongest_changes: The matched لهم constructions turn wudd into a counter-gift to the failed search for izz through acquired patrons.
The immediate move from exhaustive counting and فردا to plural beneficiaries makes affection a re-association of distinct individuals.
Rejected divine offspring redirects relational closeness away from genealogy and toward granted affection among servants.
The adjacent ودا and لدا place affection against public contentiousness and open a possible communicative mechanism.
summary.what_was_special: The trace repeatedly changes abstract love into a social mechanism: alternative value, reliable patronage, welcomed reception, post-solitary association, anti-fissure cohesion, and a speakable counter to contention.
remaining_uncertainties: The counter-gift and re-association readings are strongly sequenced but their causal arrows remain reader-supplied.
The kinship resonance of ر ح م and the wage and peg branches are activations, not claims about the ordinary lexical senses in 19:96.
19:97 may only describe delivery of the message rather than a means by which wudd is produced.
